resources.string: By tapping Grant permissions, you agree to share available call history (including older calls, cached names and SIM details) and recordings from your chosen folder with authorized company administrators. Ask your manager about consent and retention.

Call history may also be blocked by your APK installer\'s restricted-permission policy. If Android does not offer access, ask your manager to check the installer. %1$s cannot override this restriction; accessible recordings can still sync.
Edit Android Quick Settings tiles and add %1$s settings for a shortcut.
%1$s does not record calls. Choose only the folder where Samsung Phone saves recordings. Supported audio in that folder and its subfolders can be shared; unrelated storage is not scanned.
